title: MintCNA: copy number alteration profiling from single-cell DNA, ATAC and paired RNA data
description: MintCNA calls copy number alterations in single cells from scDNA-seq read counts or scATAC-seq fragment counts, optionally combined with scRNA-seq from the same cells. It denoises the count matrix with an attention-guided denoising convolutional autoencoder (AG-DCAE), finds breakpoints with a multivariate change-point scan and assigns copy-number states with a truncated Gaussian mixture model (TGMM). This archive is the release of the GitHub repository that accompanies Bao, Qin & Xiao, MintCNA: A Unified Framework for Integrative Copy Number Profiling with Single-Cell Multi-Omics Data. The reproduce/ folder holds the scripts behind every result and figure of the paper.
